The dashed has a positive left partial crest, negative trough near -pi, positive central crest, negative trough near pi and positive crest near2pi. No endpoint is point-marked.
- The dashed visibly crosses the horizontal axis four times within the crop; the solid crosses twice, at the named +/-pi positions. Both meet at the central positive crest and cross elsewhere on negative branches left/right. Those meetings/crossings have no added dots/names.
- `y = cos(x/2)` text is above the solid right descending branch. `y = cos x` is next to the dashed positive lobe near2pi. No arrowed leader accompanies either formula. No apparatus/grid/panel markers.
- Retain the source's distinct path end positions and labelled tick relationships rather than inventing a common periodic domain. In particular2pi is not the solid positive crest: its role is the negative solid trough versus positive dashed crest.
